notes.title: Fix Update! #3
notes.notes:
Thank you for enjoying and playing our game!

Some minor bugs have been fixed:

 -In the fire level of the tower area, the fire is still present when you go back from the next level, causing immediate death. (fixed)
 -Going back to previous levels in the tower level now contains the words needed to progress. (in some levels)

notes.title: Fix Update! #2
notes.notes:
Found out why some achievements weren't unlocking, especially in the first environment. Added the achievement handler back into the first environment so that should fix the issue why those achievements weren't unlocking
 Fix an issue that the books and the cat still made a sound, when the Sound Effect slider is set to 0

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes: Burning on the garden level created a pernament black screen, is now fixed.

notes.title: Fix Update! #1
notes.notes:
Thank you all for purchasing the game and thanks again to those who have reported bugs to us! 
We now have our first bug fix update with the following bugs fixed:


 After burning the books in the first environment, it no longer breaks the game
 After dying by fire, Gregory no longer coughs repetitively
 (possible) Fixed the bug after burning the cat


Demo bug fixed:


 End of demo text appears again, which makes the game no longer stuck with a white screen and the black bars

notes.title: Game release date announcement!
notes.notes:
We're very excited to announce that What's Missing? will be released on the 25th of March this year!

It feels kinda unreal to see our game be this close for release, especially after working on it for the past 2-3 years. Be sure to Wishlist the game so you will know when you can buy it, and be sure to tell your friends, family or colleagues to Wishlist it as wel ;)

~ MIG Studios

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

We have some game updates for you as we're heading to release the game near the end of the year.

To start, we have updated the menu music. Our audio composer, Jules have made a beautiful melody for the menu and updated the demo music to make the game even more atmospheric and beautiful than it already is.

We have also fixed various bugs and tweaked the design. 

And last, we have an official Discord server now! Check it out so you can follow the development more and receive the updates/testing faster! You can even chat with us if you have any questions!

Join Whats Missing?'s discord group!
